test_cases.name: O-QPSK/DSSS modulation & channel
test_cases.desc: Verify 32-chip DSSS spreading, O-QPSK, 250 kbps on each of channels 11-26 (Fc = 2405 + 5*(k-11) MHz).

test_cases.name: Receiver sensitivity / PER
test_cases.desc: Packet Error Rate at specified sensitivity; ED/CCA/LQI/RSSI readback.

test_cases.name: CSMA-CA backoff
test_cases.desc: Verify NB/BE/CW behaviour: random (2^BE - 1) backoff, CCA, retry to macMaxCSMABackoffs = 4; abort on persistent busy.

test_cases.name: Four MAC frame types
test_cases.desc: Build/parse beacon, data, acknowledgement, and MAC command frames; FCS CRC-16 check; AR/ACK handshake and retries (3).

test_cases.name: Superframe & GTS
test_cases.desc: Beacon-enabled superframe timing (BI/SD, CAP/CFP); allocate and use up to 7 GTS via GTS Request.

test_cases.name: Addressing
test_cases.desc: 16-bit PAN ID, 16-bit short and 64-bit extended (EUI-64) addressing; broadcast 0xFFFF; PAN ID compression.

test_cases.name: Association / scanning
test_cases.desc: ED/active/passive/orphan scans; Association request/response obtains a short address.

test_cases.name: Mesh routing
test_cases.desc: AODV route discovery (RREQ/RREP); multi-hop delivery through Routers; neighbor/routing table maintenance.

test_cases.name: Binding & reliable delivery
test_cases.desc: APS binding table, APS acknowledgements, fragmentation/reassembly across endpoints/clusters.

test_cases.name: Discovery
test_cases.desc: ZDO device/service discovery (NWK_addr_req, Simple_Desc_req, Match_Desc_req) and Mgmt_* requests.

test_cases.name: Cluster commands
test_cases.desc: ZCL Read/Write Attributes, Configure/Report, On/Off cluster command round-trip.

test_cases.name: AES-128 CCM* security
test_cases.desc: Encrypt/decrypt with MIC verification; 32-bit frame-counter anti-replay; network key + link key; Trust Center join.

bring_up_sequence: Configure phyCurrentChannel and PHY transmit power.
(Beacon-enabled) set macBeaconOrder / macSuperframeOrder and start the PAN.
Join the Zigbee network; receive the network key from the Trust Center.
Discover services (ZDO) and bind clusters (APS); exchange ZCL commands.
test_cases_present: partial - the spec provides functional descriptions and waveform figures that map to compliance test scenarios but does not provide a formal test plan or testbench.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Register access (read/write to all fields; reserved-bit behavior).
Nominal transfer / transaction across the protocol's operating modes.
